name: Band Lateral Raise
steps: Stand tall on the center of a resistance band with feet hip-width apart and hold the ends beside your hips.
Brace your core, keep a slight fixed bend in your elbows, and relax your shoulders away from your ears.
Raise both arms smoothly out to the sides until they reach shoulder height with your palms facing down.
Lower both hands slowly back to your thighs while resisting the band's pull throughout the descent.
tips: Lead with your elbows and stop around shoulder height to keep tension squarely on your side delts.
Avoid shrugging your traps or leaning backward to heave your arms upward.
